scope.manualAcceptance: Recorded separately in grip-evidence.json. Automated output, share, crop and root checks do not establish anatomical plausibility.

runtime.auditCommand: CHROME_EXECUTABLE=/tmp/chromium AUDIT_PORT=<unused local port> node scripts/audit-grips.mjs <output-dir> <native|matrix|inspiration>

fingerprintVerification.note: Asset sets differ by mode; each run lists exact selected input paths and its own digest. Source fingerprints omit documentation outputs.

checks.output: Full 512 cases call actual exportPng, which renders full source PNGs at1024 before downsampling. 192 cases use actual thumbnail PNG inputs. All output dimensions and PNG SHA256 are recorded.
checks.crop: Character-only alpha measured before review backgrounds; background-bearing outputs have a separately recorded transparent probe. Circle bounds are a framing diagnostic, not an anatomy test.
checks.geometry: Actual source alpha and exported bodySurface/surfaceTransform/drawTransformed functions. Root overlap is an attachment diagnostic only.
checks.share: Complete normalized state encoded, decoded and compared; drawable fallback changes are failures.

summary.note: The export size range covers the 270 actual512 matrix exports;1024 native proof files are separate review artifacts and are not subject to that size claim.

limitations: Exactly these595 states and render paths; not every possible outfit.
Full512 cases call exportPng using full-resolution assets;192 cases use actual thumbnail assets.
When output has a background, crop measurements come from the separately recorded transparent probe.
Whole/contact sheets downsample native images. Native anatomy acceptance is recorded separately.
Individual PNG files are saved for native proofs; other case PNG hashes and dimensions are measured from actual output buffers, with contact/whole sheets saved as artifacts.
Temporary proof images and raw run reports are not bundled; complete case data and fingerprints are embedded here.
No CI, deployment or production acceptance is asserted by this local record.
